user_instruction: I authorize Phase 8.5 deployment and main-campaign launch using the accepted Phase 8.4 v2 package and its verified freeze receipt. Authorize up to US$65 of incremental AWS campaign costs under the accepted policy. Preserve the US$55 estimated committed-cost admission guard, time/resource/storage limits and retention rules. Do not upgrade the AWS plan or add paid model/speech services. Before provisioning, verify the freeze, current prices, available credits and deployment configuration. Record launch authorization bound to this freeze and the actual run. Before the first execution, verify host readiness, permissions, backups and active independent shutdown timers. Run the unchanged 500 inputs across B3/P1/P2: 1,500 serial original executions in the saved order, retaining every full observation window and outcome. Use the standalone runner so execution does not depend on an active Codex conversation. Preserve failures, timeouts and UNKNOWN results. Stop admissions on defects or failed guards; do not modify frozen code, replace outcomes or automatically increase limits. Confirm when the campaign has actually started, with its run ID, start time, operational deadline and progress-check command. Follow the accepted shutdown and evidence-retention rules.
